verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Connection Timeline of historical connection events, email/webhook notifications for unspecified 'important events', and sync schedules (Scheduled, Cron, Manual). None of it shows per-destination-table freshness or an alert that fires when a pipeline misses its expected cadence. These are adjacent features, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I can tell how fresh each destination table is and get warned when a pipeline misses its expected cadence
